key_risks: Unauthorized sublease default if addendum omitted
regulatory_notes: Execute explicit written landlord corporate-housing sublease addenda on every property.
Check 30+-day occupancy tax exemptions, habitability codes and commercial liability insurance requirements.

plays.name: Insurance Additional Living Expense (ALE) Displaced-Policyholder Master-Lease Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Secure explicit landlord-authorized corporate master-leases on suitable 3–5 BR single-family homes, using approximately $2,500 monthly base rent as a market screening assumption. Seek approved displaced-family placements through ALE Solutions, CRS Temporary Housing or Sedgwick at $6,500–$9,500 monthly for 4–9 month stays. Rates, availability and carrier payment depend on local demand, policy limits and written placement authorization.
inputs: Habitable furnished 3–5 BR homes with written landlord corporate-housing and sublease authorization
Approved relocation-vendor onboarding and written placement orders defining payer, authorized rates, stay limits and cancellation terms
Property-level budget covering rent, utilities, furnishings, insurance, vacancy reserves and applicable occupancy taxes
workflow: 1. Validate local displaced-family demand and legal occupancy requirements, then obtain explicit written master-lease and sublease permissions.
2. Furnish and inspect homes, bind appropriate coverage and submit accurate availability and property details to approved relocation channels.
3. Accept placements only with verified payment responsibility, authorized stay dates and clear family-facing lease, utility and extension terms.
4. Reconcile authorized invoices, obtain written extensions before coverage expiry and manage turnover or lawful alternative leasing during placement gaps.
metrics: Collected monthly placement revenue less landlord rent, utilities, furnishing costs and operating expenses
Authorized occupied nights as a percentage of available property nights
Days sales outstanding and uncovered rent exposure after placement cancellation

platform_risks.failure_mode: Carrier-authorized stays end before the underlying master-lease obligation
platform_risks.trigger: Claim resolution, exhausted ALE limits, unapproved extension or relocation-vendor cancellation
platform_risks.impact: Vacancy losses, disputed invoices and continuing rent liability
platform_risks.detection_metric: Days of confirmed paid occupancy remaining versus unavoidable rent commitments
platform_risks.fallback: Obtain written extensions when available, activate landlord-approved alternative occupancy and use reserves or negotiated termination rights without violating tenant protections

plays.name: Commercial Hail-Swath Public Adjuster & Appraisal-Clause Storm Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Match verified commercial storm damage with licensed public-adjuster capacity and policy-specific appraisal processes, distinguishing valuation disputes from coverage questions.
inputs: Public hail-swath data and property records
Policy forms and dated damage inspections
State licensing, solicitation, and fee-limit rules
workflow: 1. Map storm footprints to commercial properties and conduct permitted owner outreach
2. Obtain authorized inspections and licensed review of coverage, deadlines, and preexisting damage
3. Submit supported estimates and invoke appraisal only where the policy and dispute allow it
4. Reconcile settlement, repairs, and lawful disclosed fees without inflating losses
metrics: Verified covered-loss rate
Days from inspection to resolved valuation
Net client proceeds after fees and deductible

platform_risks.failure_mode: Unauthorized adjusting or inapplicable appraisal demand
platform_risks.trigger: Unlicensed solicitation or use of appraisal to resolve excluded coverage issues
platform_risks.impact: Claim delay, fee forfeiture, and licensing penalties
platform_risks.detection_metric: License exceptions and appraisal requests rejected for coverage disputes
platform_risks.fallback: Pause solicitation and refer coverage disputes to qualified counsel while licensed adjusters handle supported valuations

plays.name: Municipal Code-Violation, Mechanic's Lien & Permit-Failure Lead Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Poll municipal building department portals and county recorder dockets daily for failed structural/fire inspections, expired permits, code citations, and newly filed mechanic's liens, routing exclusive real-time leads to remediation contractors and construction attorneys.
inputs: Municipal Accela/EnerGov building & code-enforcement portals
County recorder mechanic's lien & lis pendens dockets
Real-time Pay-Per-Call & exclusive CPL routing switch
workflow: Scrape and normalize daily municipal code citations, failed permit inspections, and recorded mechanic's liens across target metro counties
Enrich parcel owner contact records and classify urgency by abatement deadline or fine accrual rate
Route verified property owners via direct mail/outbound alerts into exclusive Pay-Per-Call or CPL agreements with licensed remediation contractors
metrics: Citation-to-outreach latency (hours)
Qualified homeowner/commercial call conversion %
Revenue per exclusive routed remediation lead

platform_risks.failure_mode: Municipal portal IP blocking or deceptive official-notice complaints
platform_risks.trigger: Aggressive unthrottled scraping of Accela/EnerGov portals or styling outreach like an official city abatement order
platform_risks.impact: Portal IP block or city attorney cease-and-desist notice
platform_risks.detection_metric: Portal HTTP 403/429 rate and zero municipal impersonation complaints
platform_risks.fallback: Use low-frequency scheduled API/bulk exports and clearly identify all outreach as private commercial contractor/remediation assistance

plays.name: Public-Record & API Intelligence
plays.mechanism: Ingest fragmented county dockets, probate registries, unclaimed property ledgers, and public APIs to surface uncontested claims or high-intent B2B triggers before manual competitors.
inputs: Court & probate dockets
State controller ledgers
Public licensing & entity APIs
workflow: Poll and normalize county/state record releases on an automated cadence
Cross-match entity/kinship/lien records and filter by minimum net fee threshold
Route verified dossiers into compliant outreach and claim execution
metrics: Cost per verified lead
Docket-to-contact latency (hours)
Net recovery / conversion rate

platform_risks.failure_mode: Portal rate-limiting or CAPTCHA gating
platform_risks.trigger: High-frequency automated polling against county or agency web portals
platform_risks.impact: Delayed lead ingestion or temporary IP block on target registry
platform_risks.detection_metric: HTTP 429/403 rate and daily record ingestion delta
platform_risks.fallback: Switch to scheduled bulk FOIA/public-record exports, official data feeds, and low-frequency cached queues

plays.name: Multi-Location Google Business Profile (GBP) Local-Pack Grid Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Capture high-margin Google Maps 3-Pack calls across tier-2/3 metros by partnering with real, licensed local tradespeople to co-verify legitimate physical office/shop locations, wiring call-tracking numbers and review-automation workflows to monetize excess lead capacity.
inputs: Geo-grid rank tracker identifying low-review-count Map Pack gaps in $3k+ home/commercial verticals
Joint-venture co-verification agreements with real brick-and-mortar licensed contractors
Dynamic call routing (Ringba) + automated SMS post-job review velocity loop
workflow: Identify suburban and tier-2 metro sub-markets where top-3 Google Maps competitors have <40 reviews and weak category optimization
Sign a revenue-share or pay-per-call partnership with a real local contractor or commercial office tenant (never using fake UPS boxes or virtual coworking addresses)
Optimize GBP primary/secondary categories, service-area pages, and automated customer review requests to lock top-3 Map Pack placement and bill per qualified call
metrics: Local Geo-Grid Top-3 share of voice (%)
Qualified inbound Map Pack calls per location per month
Net revenue per location ($1,500–$6,000/mo) and partner retention

platform_risks.failure_mode: Google Business Profile video-verification failure or network-wide account suspension
platform_risks.trigger: Creating fake storefront listings at UPS stores, virtual offices, or residential addresses without signage/licensing
platform_risks.impact: Immediate GBP suspension and loss of all accumulated reviews and Map Pack calls
platform_risks.detection_metric: 100% physical signage, utility bill, and state contractor license verification readiness per profile
platform_risks.fallback: Only launch GBP profiles backed by a real partner's physical shop/yard capable of passing live video verification, and pair every listing with organic city rank-and-rent pages

plays.name: Rank-and-Rent Digital Real Estate & Pay-Per-Call Routing
plays.mechanism: Build and rank local high-ticket service hubs (foundation repair, water restoration, probate liquidation, commercial roofing) wired to dynamic call-tracking switches (Ringba / Twilio) that auto-bill local operators $75–$300 per inbound call lasting over 90 seconds.
inputs: City + high-ticket emergency/specialty service domain portfolio
Ringba / Twilio dynamic number insertion (DNI) & IVR duration billing switch
Co-verified local contractor partner agreements with card-on-file auto-recharge
workflow: Launch fast programmatic local service pages and cost calculators for high-ticket, high-urgency verticals ($5,000+ average job ticket)
Partner with a licensed brick-and-mortar operator in each city for legitimate Google Business Profile co-verification while retaining ownership of the domain and tracking numbers
Route inbound prospect calls through Ringba with a 90-second duration threshold, automatically charging the partner's card on file per qualified call
metrics: Inbound calls per site per month & % of calls >90 seconds
Revenue per qualified call ($75–$300) and contractor retention rate
Portfolio gross margin (80–90% once ranked)

platform_risks.failure_mode: Google Business Profile suspension or contractor payment default
platform_risks.trigger: Registering fake Google Maps pins at UPS stores/virtual offices or delivering calls before collecting prepaid credit balances
platform_risks.impact: Loss of Map Pack call volume or uncollected call receivables
platform_risks.detection_metric: Organic-vs-Maps call split and prepaid Stripe wallet balance per partner
platform_risks.fallback: Anchor traffic in organic city/calculator pages (immune to GBP suspension), co-verify Maps only with real partner physical addresses, and enforce prepaid auto-refill call wallets

plays.name: High-Velocity DM Outbound & Trigger Funnels
plays.mechanism: Replace blind cold mass-DM blasts (which die to PeerFloodError and silent Message Request graveyards) with high-velocity comment-to-DM triggers, hand-raiser reaction hooks, and multi-inbox warm signal routing.
inputs: Short-form / community trigger posts ('Comment KEYWORD')
Signal-verified prospect handles
Automated DM qualification & booking bridge
workflow: Publish high-curiosity teardown or resource posts where prospects comment a trigger keyword or react to unlock a playbook or calculator
Deliver instant automated DM replies to warm hand-raisers (bypassing cold-DM filters because the user initiated interaction) or send contextual 1-to-1 DMs referencing an active public request
Qualify budget and timeline inside a 3-message DM micro-funnel and transition immediately to a booked call, checkout link, or owned SMS/email list
metrics: Trigger-comment to DM delivery rate
DM reply-to-qualified-conversation %
Revenue per 100 DM threads

platform_risks.failure_mode: PeerFloodError, shadow-filtering into 'Hidden Requests', or link-domain blacklisting
platform_risks.trigger: Sending identical unsolicited cold DMs with raw external URLs across freshly registered or SIM-farmed accounts
platform_risks.impact: Near-0% inbox placement, outbound DM block, or permanent account suspension
platform_risks.detection_metric: Seen/reply ratio below 10% and outbound PeerFloodError / action-block frequency
platform_risks.fallback: Require user-initiated trigger action (comment/reaction/inbound message) before automated DM dispatch and send external links only after the prospect replies

plays.name: Subsidized / Developer-Tenant Multi-Inbox Cold Outbound Infrastructure
plays.mechanism: Provisioning hundreds of isolated secondary domains across subsidized Microsoft 365 developer/partner tenants, Cloudflare Email Routing, and low-cost SMTP relays—sending strictly 15–25 plain-text emails per inbox per day across 300+ free/subsidized mailboxes to deliver 150,000+ monthly B2B cold emails into primary inboxes without paying $6–$12/seat retail Google Workspace pricing.
inputs: Lookalike secondary domain portfolio with automated SPF, DKIM (2048-bit), DMARC (`p=quarantine`/`reject`), and custom tracking-free MX records
Subsidized M365 partner/developer tenants, Cloudflare Email Routing catch-alls, and distributed SMTP sending nodes
Automated peer-to-peer warmup network and master unibox reply-routing webhook
workflow: Provision 100–300 secondary sending domains and bind 2–3 mailboxes per domain via automated DNS and tenant scripts
Warm every mailbox for 14–21 days with realistic thread-depth conversations before introducing live outbound prospects
Cap daily outbound volume at <=20 zero-link, zero-tracking-pixel plain-text messages per mailbox per day to stay completely beneath ESP volume heuristics
Aggregate all prospect replies into a single unified AI-triaged inbox that books qualified B2B sales calls on pay-per-show or retainer terms
metrics: Primary-inbox placement rate (%) across Gmail and Microsoft 365 seed tests
All-in monthly infrastructure cost per 10,000 delivered plain-text emails ($)
Positive reply rate (%) and booked meetings per 1,000 prospects contacted

platform_risks.failure_mode: Tenant-wide outbound throttling or domain-footprint blacklisting (Spamhaus DBL)
platform_risks.trigger: Placing too many domains inside a single tenant, embedding tracking pixels, or exceeding 30 sends/day per mailbox
platform_risks.impact: Tenant suspension or domain-level spam-folder routing
platform_risks.detection_metric: Daily seed-list inbox placement (%) and bounce rate (<1.5% hard threshold)
platform_risks.fallback: Enforce max 2–3 domains per tenant, strip all open/click tracking pixels, verify 100% of leads via SMTP catch-all checks before sending, and keep hot-standby warmed domains ready for instant swap

plays.name: Industry Award & Verified Directory 'Ego-Bait' Badge Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Publish data-scored state and city rankings ('Top 15 Verified Specialists in [City]') and issue free embeddable 'Top Rated' winner badges to ranked firms—earning hundreds of free high-DR backlinks when firms post the badge on their own sites, while upselling $299–$799/mo Featured #1 Lead-Capture placements.
inputs: Public state licensing, inspection, & review dataset for 500+ firms per vertical
Transparent algorithmic scoring rubric + auto-generated SVG 'Verified Top 10%' embed badges
Self-serve $299–$799/mo Featured Placement & exclusive lead-routing checkout
workflow: Score all licensed operators in a high-ticket vertical using objective public records (years licensed, zero disciplinary actions, review velocity)
Notify top-scoring firms with their free embeddable HTML/SVG '2026 Top-Scored Provider' badge (driving natural dofollow backlinks back to your directory)
Convert 5–10% of shortlisted firms into $299–$799/mo Featured Top-Spot subscribers who receive priority inbound quote requests
metrics: Badge embed rate (% of notified firms linking back to directory)
Domain Rating (DR) growth and organic city-ranking velocity
Monthly recurring revenue (MRR) from Featured Profile subscriptions

platform_risks.failure_mode: FTC endorsement/ranking disclosure scrutiny or Google widget-link spam filtering
platform_risks.trigger: Manipulating objective scores solely for pay-to-play without 'Sponsored' labels or stuffing keyword-anchor links inside badge HTML
platform_risks.impact: Loss of editorial credibility or discounting of badge backlinks
platform_risks.detection_metric: Anchor-text naturalness ratio and clear visual separation of 'Sponsored Featured Partner' vs. algorithmic score
platform_risks.fallback: Keep the underlying algorithmic score 100% objective and immutable, clearly label paid top-spot placements as 'Sponsored / Featured', and use clean branded anchor text in badge embeds

plays.name: Whitelisted Agency Ad-Spend Card-Multiplier Points & Volume-Rebate Cycling
plays.mechanism: Route genuine client-authorized advertising spend through eligible agency payment arrangements to earn contract-permitted rewards and volume rebates, net of financing, processing, and client pass-through obligations.
inputs: Client media mandates and rebate ownership clauses
Issuer reward categories, caps, and repayment terms
Platform invoices and agency volume-rebate agreements
workflow: 1. Verify client authorization, platform payment permissions, and ownership of rewards and rebates
2. Model eligible media purchases against reward caps, fees, liquidity, and rebate thresholds
3. Pay only genuine approved advertising invoices without circular spend or fabricated transactions
4. Reconcile settled rewards, client credits, refunds, and full card repayment each statement cycle
metrics: Net retained rewards and rebates per media dollar
Unfunded client exposure and repayment coverage
Invoice-to-reward reconciliation variance

platform_risks.failure_mode: Reward clawback or client-funded liquidity shortfall
platform_risks.trigger: Ineligible categories, prohibited payment aggregation, or delayed client reimbursement
platform_risks.impact: Lost rebates, interest costs, and card suspension
platform_risks.detection_metric: Denied reward value and overdue client balances versus cash reserves
platform_risks.fallback: Move to client-direct billing or prefunded approved agency terms and stop rewards-dependent spending

plays.name: "Free LLC / Free Setup" Fintech Account Co-Registration Bounty Stacking
plays.mechanism: Offering a $0-service-fee LLC formation and business-launch concierge (borrower pays only mandatory state filing fees) that embeds a sequential post-formation 'Required Business Infrastructure Checklist' where every newly formed entity opens free business banking, corporate card, payroll, bookkeeping, and merchant accounts—yielding $600–$1,800+ in stacked B2B fintech CPA bounties per free formation.
inputs: High-intent 'free LLC formation' and 'start a business in [State]' search, social, and creator traffic
Automated state SOS filing workflow, EIN retrieval assistant, and operating-agreement generator
Direct B2B partner/CPA agreements with neobank, corporate card, payroll, and registered-agent providers
workflow: Acquire first-time founders via a genuine $0-markup LLC formation funnel where the user pays only state statutory fees
Guide the founder through an automated EIN and corporate-resolution wizard immediately upon state filing submission

Present an integrated 1-click onboarding sequence for a free business checking account ($150–$400 CPA), corporate charge card ($200–$500 CPA), payroll/bookkeeping trial ($100–$300 CPA), and web/domain host ($100–$200 CPA)
Provide automated compliance reminders and annual report tracking to capture recurring Year-2 registered-agent renewals
metrics: Stacked fintech CPA bounty revenue ($) realized per 100 free LLC formations
Post-EIN bank-account funding conversion rate (%) within 14 days of formation
Net customer acquisition margin after paid search/creator traffic spend

platform_risks.failure_mode: Fintech partner CPA clawback or payout tier downgrade due to unfunded/dormant business bank accounts
platform_risks.trigger: Sending low-intent formations that open free business bank accounts but never complete KYC or initial deposit funding
platform_risks.impact: Reversal of unvested CPA bounties or shift from account-open CPA to funded-account CPA tiers
platform_risks.detection_metric: 30-day funded-account activation rate (%) and average initial deposit balance across referred LLCs
platform_risks.fallback: Gate free operating-agreement and bookkeeping templates behind verified bank-account funding and pre-qualify founders on 30-day operating revenue intent

plays.name: High-Tier "Local Guide / Autoconfirmed Editor / Top Hunter" Authority Account Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Cultivating free user accounts into high-privilege algorithmic trust tiers—such as Google Local Guides (Level 6–10), Wikipedia Autoconfirmed/Extended-Confirmed editors, Product Hunt top hunters, and G2/Capterra/Trustpilot verified reviewers—whose edits, map suggest-an-edit actions, category changes, and launches carry massive algorithmic weight and sell for high-ticket B2B retainers.
inputs: Geo-matched Google Local Guide (Level 6+), aged Wikipedia, and aged Product Hunt / software-review accounts
Location-consistent EXIF metadata, mobile device telemetry, and verifiable third-party citation dossiers
B2B local-SEO, knowledge-graph, and SaaS launch client demand
workflow: Build sustained, legitimate contribution histories across local maps, encyclopedia entries, and software ecosystems to unlock elevated platform trust tiers
Use high-tier Local Guide accounts to submit rapid-approval GBP spam-name redressals, competitor duplicate merges, and category corrections for local-service clients
Execute policy-compliant, source-backed knowledge-graph updates and high-visibility Product Hunt/directory launches for B2B SaaS brands
Package these high-trust authority interventions as premium reputation, entity-SEO, and launch-management retainers ($2,500–$10,000/mo)
metrics: Platform edit/suggestion auto-approval rate (%) and time-to-live publication
Client local-pack rank lift or knowledge-panel entity resolution rate (%)
Retainer revenue per managed authority campaign ($)

platform_risks.failure_mode: Privilege-tier badge revocation or undisclosed paid-editing enforcement
platform_risks.trigger: Submitting biased, unsourced promotional edits or executing bulk map edits outside the account's natural geographic radius
platform_risks.impact: Demotion of account trust score and rollback of historical edits
platform_risks.detection_metric: Edit acceptance/revert ratio (%) and strict geographic/topical consistency per account
platform_risks.fallback: Submit only factually verifiable, secondary-source-backed edits and keep Local Guide accounts strictly locked to their native metropolitan areas
